cards.ex: Their resentment over the broken contract became a festering wound that poisoned their business relationship.
cards.exUz: Shartnoma buzilganligi sababli ularning noroziligi biznes aloqalarini zaharlagan yara kabi chuqurlashdi.
cards.uzDef: Janjal yoki muammo vaqt o'tishi bilan yomonlashib, kuchayib borishi.

cards.ex: He didn't want to rock the boat by disagreeing with the boss.
cards.exUz: U xo'jayin bilan kelishmaslik orqali vaziyatni yomonlashtirishni xohlamadi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni yomonlashtirishi mumkin bo'lgan harakatlarni qilmoq.

cards.ex: The activists fought tooth and nail to prevent the demolition of the historical building.
cards.exUz: Faollar tarixiy binoning buzilishini oldini olish uchun qattiq kurashdilar.
cards.uzDef: Juda qattiq harakat qilmoq maqsadga erishish uchun.

cards.ex: The two companies are at loggerheads over the patent rights.
cards.exUz: Ikki kompaniya patent huquqlari bo'yicha kelishmovchilikda.
cards.uzDef: Juda katta kelishmovchilikda, nizoda bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: The land ownership remained a bone of contention between the two families for generations.
cards.exUz: Yer egaligi ikki oila o'rtasida avlodlar davomida bahs mavzusi bo'lib qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Kelishmovchilik yoki janjal sababi bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: The company faced a public backlash against its new policy.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya yangi siyosatiga qarshi jamoatchilikning noroziligiga duch keldi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga qarshi kuchli norozilik reaksiyasi.

cards.ex: The manager was in the firing line after the project failed.
cards.exUz: Loyiha muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchraganidan so'ng, menejer tanqid ostida qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Tanqid yoki hujumga duchor bo'lgan holatda bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: The negotiation resulted in a win-win situation for both parties.
cards.exUz: Muzokaralar har ikki tomon uchun ham yutuqli vaziyatga olib keldi.
cards.uzDef: Har bir tomon uchun foydali natija.

cards.ex: The CEO had to take the heat for the company's poor performance.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning yomon ko'rsatkichlari uchun bosh direktor zarbani o'ziga olishga majbur bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalar uchun tanqidni yoki aybni o'z zimmasiga olmoq.

cards.ex: Hopefully, the diplomats can find a diplomatic solution to the crisis.
cards.exUz: Umid qilamizki, diplomatlar inqirozga diplomatik yechim topa oladilar.
cards.uzDef: Muzokaralar orqali topilgan yechim, urush emas.

cards.ex: His constant complaining started to cause friction within the team.
cards.exUz: Uning doimiy shikoyatlari jamoada ishqalanishga sabab bo'la boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Kelishmovchilik yoki janjalga sabab bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: The peace talks are scheduled to begin next week.
cards.exUz: Tinchlik muzokaralari kelasi hafta boshlanishi rejalashtirilgan.
cards.uzDef: Urushayotgan tomonlar o'rtasidagi tinchlikni o'rnatish uchun muzokaralar.

cards.ex: It's important to settle differences before they escalate into major conflicts.
cards.exUz: Kelishmovchiliklar katta nizolarga aylanmasidan oldin ularni hal qilish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Kelishmovchiliklarni muhokama qilish va kelishuvga erishish.

cards.ex: The police are there to uphold the peace and maintain order.
cards.exUz: Politsiya tinchlikni saqlash va tartibni ta'minlash uchun shu yerda.
cards.uzDef: Zo'ravonlik yoki tartibsizlikning oldini olib, tinchlikni saqlash.

cards.ex: The new leader is trying to build bridges with opposing factions.
cards.exUz: Yangi lider qarama-qarshi fraktsiyalar bilan munosabatlarni yaxshilashga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Munosabatlarni yaxshilash, hamkorlikni rivojlantirish.

cards.ex: Arguing with him would just be pouring oil on the fire.
cards.exUz: U bilan bahslashish shunchaki olovga moy sepish bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni yomonlashtiradigan narsa qilish.

cards.ex: In the wake of the scandal, the CEO resigned.
cards.exUz: Janjaldan so'ng bosh direktor iste'foga chiqdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror voqeadan keyin yoki natijasida.

cards.ex: There were simmering tensions between the two departments for months.
cards.exUz: Ikki bo'lim o'rtasida bir necha oy davomida pinhoniy keskinlik mavjud edi.
cards.uzDef: Ochiq ko'rinmaydigan, lekin mavjud bo'lgan keskinlik.

cards.ex: The ceasefire agreement established a fragile truce between the warring factions.
cards.exUz: O't ochishni to'xtatish to'g'risidagi bitim urushayotgan fraktsiyalar o'rtasida nozik sulh o'rnatdi.
cards.uzDef: Osonlikcha buzilishi mumkin bo'lgan sulh.

cards.ex: The police officer tried to defuse the situation by talking calmly to the crowd.
cards.exUz: Politsiyachi olomon bilan xotirjam gaplashib, vaziyatni yumshatishga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli yoki keskin vaziyatning kuchlanishini kamaytirish.

cards.ex: I have to take issue with your interpretation of the data.
cards.exUz: Men sizning ma'lumotlarni talqin qilish uslubingiz bilan bahslashishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa bilan kelishmaslik va uni muhokama qilmoq.

cards.ex: The negotiations became a war of nerves as each side tried to intimidate the other.
cards.exUz: Muzokaralar asab urushiga aylandi, chunki har bir tomon boshqasini qo'rqitishga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Psixologik bosim va qo'rquvga asoslangan kurash.

cards.ex: His misleading statements only muddied the waters further.
cards.exUz: Uning chalg'ituvchi bayonotlari vaziyatni yanada chalkashtirib yubordi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni chalkashtirib yuborish yoki murakkablashtirish.

cards.ex: The manager poured cold water on my idea by saying it was too expensive.
cards.exUz: Menejer mening g'oyamga sovuq suv quydi va bu juda qimmat dedi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga ishtiyoqni yoki umidni yo'qotish.

cards.ex: Mixing alcohol and driving is a recipe for disaster.
cards.exUz: Alkogol ichish va mashina haydash - bu halokat retsepti.
cards.uzDef: Katta muammo yoki halokatga olib kelishi mumkin bo'lgan vaziyat.

cards.ex: I had to draw a line with my neighbor about parking on my lawn.
cards.exUz: Qo'shnimga gazonimga mashina qo'yish masalasida chiziq tortishim kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Ruxsat etilgan yoki qabul qilinadigan chegarani belgilash.

cards.ex: The government has dug its heels in and refuses to compromise.
cards.exUz: Hukumat oyoq tirab turibdi va murosaga kelishdan bosh tortmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Qaroringizda qat'iy turmoq, o'zgartirishni rad etmoq.

cards.ex: We need to nip these rumors in the bud before they spread.
cards.exUz: Bu mish-mishlar tarqalishidan oldin ularning ildizini quritishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammo boshlanishidan oldin uni to'xtatish.

cards.ex: After a long argument, they decided to bury their differences and move on.
cards.exUz: Uzoq bahsdan so'ng ular kelishmovchiliklarini unutishga va oldinga intilishga qaror qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishdagi kelishmovchiliklarni unutib, yarashmoq.

cards.ex: There's often a clash of interests between developers and environmentalists.
cards.exUz: Ko'pincha quruvchilar va ekologlar o'rtasida manfaatlar to'qnashuvi bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Turli guruhlar yoki shaxslarning qarama-qarshi maqsadlari.
